label: Constraints as a weighted graph
subgoals: Draw an edge from i to j of weight w for each constraint
Relax edges in topological order to get the longest paths

label: Upper bounds become backward edges
subgoals: Rewrite each upper bound as a lower bound with negated weight
Relax all edges repeatedly until no start time changes

label: Feasibility and positive cycles
subgoals: Find the longest forward path between the constrained operations
Close the cycle with the backward edge
Require the cycle weight to be at most zero
